abstract: High voltage irradiation of the iliac and paraaortic lymph nodes for seminoma testis induces a grave, acute blood lymphocytopenia. A major part of this effect is probably caused by irradiation of the blood. Indications are presented that B lymphocytes are more gravely affected than T lymphocytes. It is possible that the treatment leaves a relatively radioresistant subpopulation of lymphocytes, mostly consisting of T lymphocytes. The total number of blood lymphocytes is normalized five to ten years after treatment. Six months after treatment the percentage of B lymphocytes is clearly higher than normal, remaining so for the first three years. The percentage of T lymphocytes is unchanged both during therapy and at all intervals thereafter. The results therefore indicate that the number of B lymphocytes is more rapidly normalized after radiotherapy than that of T lymphocytes, and that the post-irradiation lymphocytopenia is mainly a T lymphocytopenia. However, this shift in B/T lymphocyte ratio is not permanent, being completely or nearly normalized after ten years. This pattern of regeneration seems to be essentially the same in patients who have received additional treatment to the mediastinum, probably meaning that the thymus has only a marginal influence on the regeneration of T lymphocytes in the adult organism. It is possible that the rapid recovery of B lymphocytes relates to the ability of the bone marrow to extend into non-irradiated parts of the skeleton after radiation destruction.
abstract_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対して腸骨および傍大動脈リンパ節に高電圧放射線療法を行うと、急性の重度な血中リンパ球減少が生じる。この影響の大部分は血液の照射によると考えられる。B細胞はT細胞よりも重度に影響を受けるようである。治療後には比較的放射線抵抗性のリンパ球亜集団、主にT細胞からなる集団が残る可能性がある。リンパ球総数は治療後5～10年で正常化する。治療後6か月ではB細胞の割合が正常より明らかに高く、その状態は最初の3年間続く。T細胞の割合は治療中およびその後のすべての時点で変化しない。したがって、放射線療法後はB細胞数がT細胞数より速やかに正常化し、照射後のリンパ球減少は主にT細胞減少である。しかし、このB/T比の変化は永続的ではなく、10年後には完全またはほぼ正常化する。縦隔への追加治療を受けた患者でも同様の回復パターンが認められ、成人においてT細胞の再生に対する胸腺の影響は限定的であると考えられる。B細胞の急速な回復は、放射線による骨髄破壊後に骨髄が非照射部位の骨格へ拡大できることと関連している可能性がある。
